protocol.lead: target patch start minus visible patch start; at 6s the post-origin gap is 4s
protocol.sites: per modality/dataset: <=2 by training patch coverage; tie by name
protocol.base: dataset, Hb site, EEG site mask, crop phase/phase^2, log EEG RMS per site at t and t-h; target-site Hb word, levels, slopes, log RMS at t/t-1/t-2
protocol.shifted: same histogram moved from t to strictly past t-h, fit on wrong-time train inputs
protocol.continuous: measured current alpha/beta mean and SD over the same EEG sites
protocol.delta: target-site signed mean at t+h minus mean at t; train variance per color/lag
protocol.word: future Hb pattern, independent ridge one-hot target, simplex projection, summed K-way Brier
protocol.effects: pattern fit: unit EEG histogram minus weighted train mixture, base fixed, raw delta units
protocol.rate_scope: incremental EEG word bits per distinct origin x contributing EEG sites, not per Hb target; do not sum horizons. Common features and physical EEG attributes are side information, not a zero-rate end-to-end codec.
protocol.averaging: equal sites/origin, origins/crop, crops/record, records/subject, subjects/dataset, datasets
protocol.ci: paired 95% percentile; macro resamples datasets then subjects within each drawn copy; per-dataset resamples subjects; no window/position replicates or subject-level CI
protocol.ci_conditional_on: frozen models and scored validation cohort
protocol.multiplicity: 6s joint delta prespecified: all three paired lower limits >0; other endpoints/contrasts descriptive
